content.short: A launchpad for creators, a marketplace for collectors. Welcoming creators globally to onboard and create NFTs with us.
content.description:
Dropspot NFT marketplace is a creator focused platform, with a mission to bring amazing creators and projects to the Cardano NFT ecosystem.

With a free mint service, we put our creators first, removing a large barrier to entry for those new to web 3. Dropspot’s creator launchpad is the easiest way to create and mint NFTs for sale on Cardano through a set of awesome smart contracts. Dropspot offers a number of mechanisms to distribute NFTs via pre-mint sale, live mint reveal or QR code claim.

Putting creators firmly in the spotlight, Dropspot has a community and creation team that will help promote and seed amazing NFTs to the globe. Committed to creators, we have implemented perpetual royalties for both single and multiple recipients.

Our marketplace is easy to use, performant and offers a great experience for Cardano NFT collectors.
